llm_judge.c4_no_fabrication.spec_item: 状态感知（沿用已确定映射）

C1.criterion: 仅两种报告文件可读，五类主题有实质内容；不要求独立辅助附件

public: exec/06_报告模板.docx / 来源说明
原始材料的项目、任务与问题 ID
C2.criterion: 按报告已陈述事实组评价 ID 关联与来源定位；接受跨表关联和共用来源说明。完全遗漏的条件或其他事实组仅计 C3，不因未写入的备注再扣 C2。

scoring.semantic_formula: (correct association components + locatable source components) / (2 * present fact families including foreign units)
scoring.within_family: any wrong association or unlocatable asserted fact fails that component; duplicates carry no extra weight
scoring.rule_formula: correct asserted ID/name/department/priority-issue relations divided by asserted relations plus foreign task IDs; missing content assessed in C3

public: 三部门 DOCX / 各任务目标与安排、脚注
C3.criterion: 目标24、安排/责任人/日期72、限定36三组分别计算正确覆盖率，取最低组；实质矛盾或捏造为0。报告各组及全部132项覆盖。

C4.spec_item: 状态感知（沿用已确定映射）
public: exec/06_报告模板.docx / 待确认事项
evidence: final answer in raw trace when it discusses unknowns
C4.criterion: 4项状态与4项原因在表格和待确认事项中保持未知，列明来源及待确认责任人；回答无需重复列项但不得补造

semantic_thresholds.0.0: any fabrication or at least 5 incomplete
semantic_thresholds.counting: each of eight semantic gaps once; shared named owner via ID accepted, department only insufficient

C4.interpretation: 结合正文、表格、符号说明及来源判断，不要求固定表头或未知措辞；有明确说明的“—”可表示未知，未解释的空白不能自动视为未知。原有完整性及不得补造要求不变。

semantic_protocol.items: eight unknown_items from Judge; no automatic header/unknown-word detection
semantic_protocol.null_fields: undetermined unless another item proves fabrication

C5.criterion: 真实应用中编辑正文和全部含目标任务的必需表格，保存重开验证标记

C6.criterion: 评测端全页检查可读性和两版对应；从1分按缺陷实际影响扣分。同一缺陷跨页/版本只扣一次。内容覆盖遗漏计 C3。

scoring.minor_example: 局部需回看表头或接续行但含义完整
scoring.moderate_example: 明显增加阅读成本但内容仍可恢复
scoring.major_example: 局部实质内容截断、不可读或两版事实不同
scoring.critical_example: 核心章节/整表不可用、正文图片化或系统性两版不一致
required_evidence: deduplicated defects with id, severity, impact, page citations

C7.criterion: 五类同次实际复核等权；语义完成程度标记0/0.5/1，实际计分0/0.25/1。来源实际复核、有意义两版抽查及不要求Agent看图的边界不变。

coverage_policy.sources: 保持来源可追溯和实际复核口径；按任务或共用口径核对，允许穿插编写过程
coverage_policy.facts: 核对实际报告事实、统计结果或未知信息
coverage_policy.tables_figures: 接受非视觉数据、标签、结构或导出内容检查，不要求图像输入
coverage_policy.editability: 接受实际可编辑结构检查或副本编辑保存重开；与评测端 C5 区分
coverage_policy.docx_pdf_equivalence: 实际比较两版对应内容；允许有意义抽查，不固定深度

tolerances.percentage_points: 按展示精度四舍五入：±0.5 × 10^(-小数位数) 个百分点；不强制小数位数
tolerances.semantic_paraphrase: allowed if scope and meaning preserved
tolerances.layout: 无固定分页、表头或脚注形式；微小美观差异不扣分，仍验收可读性

aggregation: Keep fixed 0.6/0.4 and within-group weights; exclude nulls as before and label partial evidence provisional. Task score=max(0, weighted score - sum of fixed deduction bands), max one band per C. Missing-delivery deductions suppress derivative C2-C6 deductions. Deductions do not change checkpoint/capability scores. Collapse same-C subchecks using group*within-group weights, then equal-C capability mean; uncovered dimensions null.

packaging.runtime_evidence: external evaluation output directory; not the static task workspace
packaging.gt_contents: truth, manifests, reference deliverables and private revision regression; never distributed to candidate
packaging.cleanup_status: Existing retired-file cleanup remains blocked; Automatic approval review rejected recursive cleanup of gt/.material_hint_revision/ with blocked by policy; no more specific reason supplied. Private temporary authoring files are excluded from distribution.
packaging.fresh_workspace_required: Do not retain retired 00_材料说明.md from earlier runs

numeric_adapter.rule_aggregation: independent numeric scores; common v2 group uses equal mean
numeric_adapter.unresolved: raise evaluator error; never substitute zero

report_embedded_requirements.sources: 注释或附录：对应报告章节/表图或任务 ID、来源文件、版本及具体定位，可合并共用口径
report_embedded_requirements.unknowns: 待确认事项章节：8项缺失状态/原因、任务/问题 ID、来源及待确认责任人
report_embedded_requirements.self_verification: 实际复核来源、内容与一致性；非视觉方式和有效抽查可接受，不要求独立检查记录

rubric_hash_format: UTF-8 LLM Judge Rubric section body, LF newlines, outer whitespace stripped

rule_cases.case: only required DOCX and PDF, no auxiliary files
extra auxiliary files do not alter score

c7_state_cases.case: complete trace confirms self claim only
complete trace confirms all five scopes

task_score_caps.requirement: confirmed defect evidence only, not uncertainty itself
task_score_caps.numeric_unknown_interaction: known wrong numbers retain caps even if other fields are unparsed
task_score_caps.business_only: caps do not enter YAML or capability scores
task_score_caps.public_runner_support: not implemented; use embedded six-state aggregate

extraction_policy.headers: Explicit aliases, slash/newline pairs and context wrappers; task-ID/name and issue-ID/reason compound cells, completion/planned and acceptance passed/sample pairs supported. Field order follows candidate headers or complete value labels, never GT.
extraction_policy.acceptance: Passed/total (including sample count), passed/failed or reverse order; total=passed+failed. Ambiguous or unmatched pair syntax is undetermined; parseable errors retained.
extraction_policy.joins: task ID across tables; issue-only rows use explicit candidate task/issue links, never private fact ordering
extraction_policy.duplicates: equivalent repeated assertions allowed; conflicting values retained and penalized
extraction_policy.unknown_layout: undetermined with extraction diagnostics, never automatic zero
extraction_policy.candidate_scope: actual DOCX content; source index or candidate configuration is not trusted
extraction_policy.confirmed_errors: Retain parseable wrong values when other fields are unparsed; confirmed errors may trigger a banded deduction on the provisional total.
extraction_policy.identifiers: Canonical ASCII-delimited IDs extracted before whitespace removal; adjacent Chinese, fullwidth forms and descriptive suffixes allowed. Multiple or malformed IDs require semantic review, never classified as foreign by raw cell text.
extraction_policy.provenance: Direct and compound observations retain original cell text and table/row/column locator; derived pass+fail totals use column 0 and preserve component observations.

review_protocol.computed_by: task embedded cN_from_review functions; Judge supplied totals ignored
review_protocol.calibration: required for formal apply_review; not claimed by regression fixtures

material_revision_validation.scope: Author material integrity and rendering checks only; no evaluated Agent run or Judge calibration

visual_review.workbook_changed_ranges_reviewed: A1:I8 on all seven sheets, including the hidden supplement
visual_review.findings: No new clipping or overlap observed; existing layout preserved

material_revision_validation.packaged_docx_renderer: Unavailable: LibreOffice soffice.exe not installed; actual WPS export used
material_revision_validation.cleanup_status: Automatic approval review rejected recursive cleanup of gt/.material_hint_revision/ with blocked by policy; no more specific reason supplied. Private temporary authoring files are excluded from distribution.

task_score_deductions.formula: max(0, weighted_task_score - sum(max deduction per C))
task_score_deductions.deduplication: One largest deduction per C across rule/semantic triggers; independent Cs add. With missing report(s), only C1 and independently evidenced C7 receive additional deductions.
task_score_deductions.insufficient_evidence: No charge for uncertainty or evaluator failure; confirmed errors remain deductible even when another field is unresolved.
task_score_deductions.business_only: Does not affect YAML mapping, raw checkpoint scores, or capability scores.
task_score_deductions.public_runner_support: Not implemented; use embedded six-state aggregate.
task_score_deductions.legacy_alias: uncapped_task_score equals weighted_task_score; cap fields removed
